method.channels: Sampled posed local bone rotate, translate.x/y, scale.x/y, shear.x/y (including held components), deform offsets per coordinate, and actually applied slider mapped-time; channelStatus/channelRefusals describe independent failures. Deform series with one display-name path but different original sources are refused individually; independent of geometry pair. No key-time interpolation outside this grid.
method.geometry: Exhaustive frame pairs i<j; distance=max over corresponding original attachment vertices of hypot2(dx,dy)=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy), dx/dy in world units (the shared deterministic length helper).
method.ties: First in frame-grid order; geometry ties keep earliest (i,j), then attachment identity in UTF-16 code-unit order, then vertex index. Timestamps are copied from sampled frames.
method.geometryScope: Original region/mesh vertices, before clipping, occlusion and tint alpha; filtered explicitly by --slot/--hide. Changing attachment source identity/count is refused, including different sources with equal display names and vertex counts.
method.panels: setup | min | max | abs(max-min) | abs(min-setup) | abs(max-setup). min/max label earlier/later frame of the geometry pair, not joint channel minima/maxima. Native viewport size and scale, legend appended below.
method.diff: L=round(max(abs(Ra*Aa/255-Rb*Ab/255),abs(Ga*Aa/255-Gb*Ab/255),abs(Ba*Aa/255-Bb*Ab/255),abs(Aa-Ab))); opaque (L,L,L,255) on black. No amplification or scaling.
